_note: Cross-family blend (Roman + Mesopotamian): a supreme law-giving empire - the Mesopotamian law-code and god-king tradition under a Romanizing legal and administrative order. Backbone = Akkadian (near_eastern: phonology, the alu cities, the sharru ladder); overlay = Latinate (classical: Roman legal/administrative register, Imperator/Praefectus/Legio, -us offices). civ = feudal. LAWFUL ALONE (the apex order-empire). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Akkadian/Latin registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon drawn from both parents' sets (Akkadian primary, Latinate variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Akkadian backbone (sh, ', kh, ts, q; vowels a i u; endings -u/-tu/-um; mimation) with a Latinate overlay (a Romanizing legal/administrative register; -us/-or office-endings); theophoric on the Akkadian morphs (Tullaru-, Argantu-, Urlandu-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; mimation -um; construct chains; the Latin overlay adds -us/-or in offices and names.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic 'mar' (son of); theophoric given names on the morphed god-stems; a Latinate gens/-us form for the higher magistracy and the legions.
morphology.compounding_rule: construct chains: Bit-[god/name] (house of), Dur-[ruler] (fort of), Kar-[god] (port of); the Latin overlay yields Colonia-[name] and -us magistracies.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a law-empire: the Sharru-Imperator over the peerage and the Confucian-strict magistracy; the law-code and the legions sustain the order)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Akkadian backbone, ascending, with a Latinate administrative overlay. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march, over a Latin-styled Limis (frontier); Shaknu (appointed governor) county, ruling a Praefectura; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom; Shar-kishshati (king of the totality), styled in the Latin overlay Imperator, over the Kishshatu. The legions (Legio) and the law-code (the dinu) are the empire's spine. (Rank titles are the real Akkadian/Latin register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king / crown prince)

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + patronymic (mar-X); the magistracy and legions take a Latinate gens + -us name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the temple-and-city register is Akkadian; the imperial magistracy and the legions use Latinate -us names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names from the morphed deity-names + an Akkadian verb: X-iddina (X-gave), X-uballit (X-kept-alive), Warad-X (servant-of-X). e.g. Tullaru-iddina, Warad-Urlandu.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Akkadian primary, from near_eastern theonym_sets; Latinate canon-form as the learned variant), never real Mesopotamian/Roman gods. Sargonid is Lawful alone: the apex law-empire reveres the One (Itarnu) above His ministers and the Lawful powers as the celestial magistracy that gave the law; the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals it exists to suppress. The law-stele and the temple-tower (ziggurat) are the altars.
religion.the_one: Itarnu (< Aeternus; Latinate variant Aeternus - the supreme Lawgiver of Heaven, source of the Mandate of order, revered above all)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tullaru (sun and judgment, lord of the law-stele; Lawful)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numunu (the scribe-wisdom, keeper of the code; Lawful)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals the empire suppresses, each with a portfolio epithet ('-lemnu' = evil): Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner; Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking; Lusanto -> Lusantu the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (god-house/ziggurat) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru'; the law-court keeps its stele in the Latin overlay as the Curia.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and just magistrates inscribed on the temple-stele; 'the Just [name]' / Latin 'Divus [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Numunu: stylus on a clay tablet beneath the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron oath-ring crossed with the legion's standard

banks_patterns.ships: river-barge and war-galley names: 'Pride of the Naru', 'Boat of Tullaru', 'the Aquila' (Latin overlay)
banks_patterns.military_units: the Legio of [number/god] / the [god] Standard: 'the Legio of Urlandu', 'the First Standard'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and dead cities: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Ekallu'
